wrong_terms: a reviewer sees what the branch added
stale_recent_at_top.rationale: An earlier convention from when .gitignore was maintained by hand and additions were kept directly under the header so a reviewer could see at a glance what a branch had added. Superseded by the real session's move to script-generated ordering. Applying it puts dist2/ first where the factless hand-append puts it last, so the two failures are separable by position alone.
stale_recent_at_top.term_choice: A plant saying 'add the line to the file' would reproduce naive.py's bottom append. The planted rule must specify a POSITION that a hand-append would not naturally produce.
